benchmark: Google Quantum AI VQCC - Benchmark I (1/sqrt(x) phasing)
metric: score = Q * (Toffolis + T/4); lower is better; combined_score = reference_score / score

constraints.register_schema: exactly one register 'x' with 22 distinct qubits
constraints.scratch: all non-x qubits must return to |0>
constraints.tolerance: phase error in turns <= 2^-24 / sqrt(x); exhaustive over x
